package handlers

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"net/http"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/queryfields"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/transport/http/admin/v1/middleware"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/transport/http/admin/v1/parsers"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/usecase/contentaccess"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/usecase/lesson"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/usecase/lessonrevision"
	"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"
	"github.com/go-playground/validator/v10"
)

// LessonHandler handles lesson endpoints.
type LessonHandler struct {
	RevisionsUC lessonrevision.Definitions
	Validator   *validator.Validate
	CreateUC    lesson.CreateLesson
	UpdateUC    lesson.UpdateLesson
	DeleteUC    lesson.DeleteLesson
	GetUC       lesson.GetLesson
	ListUC      lesson.ListLessonsByCourse
	MaterialsUC lesson.GetLessonMaterials
	Access      contentaccess.Service
}

type lessonTranslationRequest struct {
	I18nID      int    `json:"i18n_id" validate:"required,min=1"`
	Title       string `json:"title" validate:"required,max=255"`
	Excerpt     string `json:"excerpt" validate:"required"`
	Description string `json:"description" validate:"required"`
}

type internalLessonResponse struct {
	ID          string `json:"id"`
	CourseID    string `json:"course_id,omitempty"`
	SectionID   string `json:"section_id"`
	Title       string `json:"title"`
	Excerpt     string `json:"excerpt"`
	Description string `json:"description"`
	Order       int    `json:"order"`
	Status      int    `json:"status"`
}

type lessonVersionRequest struct {
	TechVersionID int  `json:"tech_version_id" validate:"required,min=1"`
	Status        *int `json:"status" validate:"omitempty,oneof=0 1"`
}

// CreateLessonRequest body.
type CreateLessonRequest struct {
	ID               string                     `json:"id" validate:"omitempty,uuid"`
	SourceKey        string                     `json:"source_key" validate:"omitempty,max=255"`
	Title            string                     `json:"title" validate:"required,max=255"`
	Excerpt          string                     `json:"excerpt" validate:"required"`
	Description      string                     `json:"description" validate:"required"`
	Status           *int                       `json:"status" validate:"omitempty,oneof=0 1"`
	LessonReadAccess *domain.LessonReadAccess   `json:"lesson_read_access" validate:"omitempty,oneof=guest student student_pro disabled"`
	Versions         []lessonVersionRequest     `json:"versions" validate:"omitempty,dive"`
	Translations     []lessonTranslationRequest `json:"translations" validate:"omitempty,dive"`
	ComposeConfig    json.RawMessage            `json:"compose_config"`
}

// Create handles creation.
func (h LessonHandler) Create(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	var req CreateLessonRequest
	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req); err != nil {
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}
	if err := h.Validator.Struct(req); err != nil {
		writeValidationError(w, err)
		return
	}
	lesson, err := h.CreateUC.Handle(r.Context(), lesson.CreateLessonInput{
		ID:               req.ID,
		SourceKey:        req.SourceKey,
		Title:            req.Title,
		Excerpt:          req.Excerpt,
		Description:      req.Description,
		Translations:     mapLessonTranslations(req.Translations),
		Versions:         mapLessonVersions(req.Versions),
		ComposeConfig:    req.ComposeConfig,
		Status:           req.Status,
		LessonReadAccess: req.LessonReadAccess,
	})
	if err != nil {
		if err == domain.ErrConflict {
			http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusConflict)
			return
		}
		if errors.Is(err, domain.ErrValidation) {
			http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusUnprocessableEntity)
			return
		}
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusInternalServerError)
		return
	}
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusCreated)
	_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(lesson)
}

// List returns lessons for a course id.
func (h LessonHandler) List(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	courseID := chi.URLParam(r, "courseID")
	fieldsParam := r.URL.Query().Get("fields")

	// Parse and validate fields
	f := queryfields.Parse(fieldsParam, queryfields.LessonAllowedFields)
	responseIncludesID := f.Has("id")
	queryFields := f.Including("id")

	// Parse filters and sort from query parameters
	filters, err := parsers.ParseLessonFilters(r, h.Validator)
	if err != nil {
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}
	sort := parsers.ParseSortOptions(r)

	if courseID != "" {
		if filters.CourseID != nil && *filters.CourseID != courseID {
			http.Error(w, "course_id does not match path", http.StatusBadRequest)
			return
		}
		filters.CourseID = &courseID
	} else if filters.CourseID != nil {
		courseID = *filters.CourseID
	}

	_, role, authenticated := middleware.UserFromContext(r.Context())
	privileged := authenticated && isPositionPrivilegedRole(role)
	if !privileged {
		active := domain.LessonStatusActive
		filters.Status = &active
		switch {
		case filters.CourseID != nil:
			err = h.Access.RequireCourse(r.Context(), *filters.CourseID)
		case filters.ModuleID != nil:
			err = h.Access.RequireModule(r.Context(), *filters.ModuleID)
		case filters.SectionID != nil:
			err = h.Access.RequireSection(r.Context(), *filters.SectionID)
		default:
			err = domain.ErrNotFound
		}
		if err != nil {
			writeContentAccessError(w, err)
			return
		}
	}

	lessons, total, err := h.ListUC.HandleWithFields(r.Context(), courseID, queryFields, filters, sort)
	if err != nil {
		if err == domain.ErrNotFound {
			http.Error(w, "not found", http.StatusNotFound)
			return
		}
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusInternalServerError)
		return
	}

	// Ensure we return empty array instead of null
	if lessons == nil {
		lessons = []map[string]any{}
	}
	if !privileged && len(lessons) > 0 {
		lessonIDs := make([]string, 0, len(lessons))
		for _, item := range lessons {
			if lessonID, ok := item["id"].(string); ok && lessonID != "" {
				lessonIDs = append(lessonIDs, lessonID)
			}
		}
		decisions, err := h.Access.ResolveLessons(r.Context(), lessonIDs, false)
		if err != nil {
			writeContentAccessError(w, err)
			return
		}
		for _, item := range lessons {
			lessonID, _ := item["id"].(string)
			decision, ok := decisions[lessonID]
			if !ok {
				decision.Effective = domain.DefaultLessonReadAccess
			}
			item["effective_read_access"] = decision.Effective
			item["can_read"] = decision.CanRead
			if decision.SourceType != "" {
				item["read_access_source_type"] = decision.SourceType
			}
			if !decision.CanRead {
				delete(item, "description")
				delete(item, "translations")
				delete(item, "compose_config")
			}
			if !responseIncludesID {
				delete(item, "id")
			}
		}
	} else if !responseIncludesID {
		for _, item := range lessons {
			delete(item, "id")
		}
	}

	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]any{
		"lessons": lessons,
		"meta":    buildPaginationMeta(filters.Page, filters.Limit, total),
	})
}

// UpdateLessonRequest body.
type UpdateLessonRequest struct {
	Title            string                     `json:"title" validate:"required,max=255"`
	Excerpt          string                     `json:"excerpt" validate:"required"`
	Description      string                     `json:"description" validate:"required"`
	Versions         []lessonVersionRequest     `json:"versions" validate:"omitempty,dive"`
	Translations     []lessonTranslationRequest `json:"translations" validate:"omitempty,dive"`
	ComposeConfig    optionalRawMessage         `json:"compose_config"`
	Status           int                        `json:"status" validate:"oneof=0 1"`
	LessonReadAccess optionalLessonReadAccess   `json:"lesson_read_access"`
}

// Update handles PUT /admin/lessons/{lessonID}.
func (h LessonHandler) Update(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	lessonID := chi.URLParam(r, "lessonID")
	var req UpdateLessonRequest
	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req); err != nil {
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}
	if err := h.Validator.Struct(req); err != nil {
		writeValidationError(w, err)
		return
	}
	var composeConfig *[]byte
	if req.ComposeConfig.Set {
		cfg := []byte(req.ComposeConfig.Value)
		composeConfig = &cfg
	}
	lesson, err := h.UpdateUC.Handle(r.Context(), lesson.UpdateLessonInput{
		LessonID:            lessonID,
		Title:               req.Title,
		Excerpt:             req.Excerpt,
		Description:         req.Description,
		Translations:        mapLessonTranslations(req.Translations),
		Versions:            mapLessonVersions(req.Versions),
		ComposeConfig:       composeConfig,
		Status:              req.Status,
		LessonReadAccess:    req.LessonReadAccess.Value,
		LessonReadAccessSet: req.LessonReadAccess.Set,
	})
	if err != nil {
		if err == domain.ErrNotFound {
			http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusNotFound)
			return
		}
		if err == domain.ErrConflict {
			http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusConflict)
			return
		}
		if errors.Is(err, domain.ErrValidation) {
			http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusUnprocessableEntity)
			return
		}
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusInternalServerError)
		return
	}
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
	_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(lesson)
}

// Get handles GET /lessons/{lessonID}.
func (h LessonHandler) Get(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	lessonID := chi.URLParam(r, "lessonID")
	var readDecision contentaccess.LessonReadDecision
	if !isPrivilegedRequest(r) {
		var err error
		readDecision, err = h.Access.AuthorizeLesson(r.Context(), lessonID, r.URL.Query().Get(relationAccessQueryParam))
		if err != nil {
			writeContentAccessError(w, err)
			return
		}
	} else {
		readDecision = contentaccess.LessonReadDecision{Effective: domain.DefaultLessonReadAccess, CanRead: true}
	}
	fieldsParam := r.URL.Query().Get("fields")

	// Parse and validate fields
	f := queryfields.Parse(fieldsParam, queryfields.LessonAllowedFields)

	result, err := h.GetUC.HandleWithFields(r.Context(), lessonID, f)
	if err != nil {
		if err == domain.ErrNotFound {
			http.Error(w, "not found", http.StatusNotFound)
			return
		}
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusInternalServerError)
		return
	}
	result["effective_read_access"] = readDecision.Effective
	result["can_read"] = readDecision.CanRead
	if readDecision.SourceType != "" {
		result["read_access_source_type"] = readDecision.SourceType
	}

	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(result)
}

// GetInternalLesson returns lesson metadata for internal consumers.
func (h LessonHandler) GetInternalLesson(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	lessonID := chi.URLParam(r, "lessonID")
	item, err := h.GetUC.Handle(r.Context(), lessonID)
	if err != nil {
		if err == domain.ErrNotFound {
			http.Error(w, "not found", http.StatusNotFound)
			return
		}
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusInternalServerError)
		return
	}

	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(internalLessonResponse{
		ID:          item.ID,
		CourseID:    item.CourseID,
		SectionID:   item.SectionID,
		Title:       item.Title,
		Excerpt:     item.Excerpt,
		Description: item.Description,
		Order:       item.Order,
		Status:      item.Status,
	})
}

// Delete handles DELETE /admin/lessons/{lessonID}.
func (h LessonHandler) Delete(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	lessonID := chi.URLParam(r, "lessonID")
	if err := h.DeleteUC.Handle(r.Context(), lesson.DeleteLessonInput{LessonID: lessonID}); err != nil {
		if err == domain.ErrNotFound {
			http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusNotFound)
			return
		}
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusInternalServerError)
		return
	}
	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusNoContent)
}

func mapLessonTranslations(translations []lessonTranslationRequest) []domain.LessonI18n {
	result := make([]domain.LessonI18n, 0, len(translations))
	for _, translation := range translations {
		result = append(result, domain.LessonI18n{
			I18nID:      translation.I18nID,
			Title:       translation.Title,
			Excerpt:     translation.Excerpt,
			Description: translation.Description,
		})
	}
	return result
}

func mapLessonVersions(versions []lessonVersionRequest) []domain.LessonVersion {
	result := make([]domain.LessonVersion, 0, len(versions))
	for _, version := range versions {
		status := domain.LessonVersionStatusActive
		if version.Status != nil {
			status = *version.Status
		}
		result = append(result, domain.LessonVersion{
			TechVersionID: version.TechVersionID,
			Status:        status,
		})
	}
	return result
}
